people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Solomon
people.line: Son of David, king of Israel, known for his wisdom.

translations.web: But king Solomon will be blessed, and David’s throne will be established before Yahweh forever.”
translations.bsb: But King Solomon will be blessed and David’s throne will remain secure before the LORD forever.”
translations.kjv: And king Solomon shall be blessed, and the throne of David shall be established before the LORD for ever.
translations.asv: But king Solomon shall be blessed, and the throne of David shall be established before Jehovah for ever.
